import json,hashlib,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import replace
from bass.background.bianchi_types import build_bianchi_algebra
from bass.background.convention_bridge import build_structure_tensor_with_sign
from bass.background.tilted_bianchi_state import SpeciesFluidCongruence,construct_admissible_tilted_state,evaluate_tilted_constraints
from bass.background.initial_conditions import CodazziProjectionError
base=Path("docs/research_program/observational_publication_20261015/R62_ANISOTROPY_CLASSIFICATION_20261117")
files=[Path("htt/bass/background/tilted_bianchi_state.py"),Path("tests/r62/test_constraint_units.py"),base/"REVIEW/R62_F1_REPAIR.patch",base/"RESULTS/R62_F1_TEST_RECEIPT.json",base/"RESULTS/R62_F1_TESTS.txt"]
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
before={str(p):sha(p) for p in files if p.exists()}
single=SpeciesFluidCongruence(species="cdm",eps_hat=1.,p_hat=0.,v_vec=[.1,0,0]);opposite=SpeciesFluidCongruence(species="baryon",eps_hat=1.,p_hat=0.,v_vec=[-.1,0,0])
rows=[]
for coupling in (1.,8*np.pi*6.67430e-11/299792458.**4,1e30):
 try:construct_admissible_tilted_state(family="I",species=[single],kappa=coupling)
 except CodazziProjectionError as e:reject=True
 else:raise AssertionError("forbidden Type-I tilt still admitted")
 state=construct_admissible_tilted_state(family="I",species=[single,opposite],kappa=coupling)
 assert state.constraints.is_admissible
 bad=evaluate_tilted_constraints(family="I",algebra=state.algebra,geometry=state.geometry,H=2*state.H,sigma_ab=state.sigma_ab,total_matter=state.total_matter,kappa=coupling)
 assert not bad.is_admissible and abs(bad.normalized_residuals["hamiltonian"]-.6)<1e-14
 rows.append({"kappa":coupling,"single_tilt_rejected":reject,"compensating_flux_admitted":state.constraints.is_admissible,"wrong_H_normalized_residual":bad.normalized_residuals["hamiltonian"]})
ix=[]
for L,E in [(1.,1.),(1e-22,1.),(1e12,1e5)]:
 a=np.zeros(3);n=L*np.diag([1.,2.,3.]);alg=replace(build_bianchi_algebra("IX"),a=a,n=n,C=build_structure_tensor_with_sign(a,n))
 sig=L*np.array([[0.,.1,0],[.1,0,0],[0,0,0]]);beta=np.array([0,0,-.1/4.99]);rho=4.99*E
 dust=SpeciesFluidCongruence(species="cdm",eps_hat=rho*(1-beta@beta),p_hat=0.,v_vec=beta)
 opts=dict(family="IX",algebra=alg,H=L,closure="hold_H",species=[dust],kappa=L*L/E)
 state=construct_admissible_tilted_state(sigma_ab=sig,**opts)
 assert state.constraints.is_admissible
 try:construct_admissible_tilted_state(sigma_ab=1.1*sig,**opts)
 except CodazziProjectionError:reject=True
 else:raise AssertionError("unit-scaled bad IX state admitted")
 ix.append({"L":L,"E":E,"admitted":state.constraints.is_admissible,"max_normalized_residual":max(state.constraints.normalized_residuals.values()),"perturbed_shear_rejected":reject})
after={str(p):sha(p) for p in files if p.exists()}
report=json.loads((base/"RESULTS/R62_F1_TEST_RECEIPT.json").read_text())
assert report["state_sha256"]==after["htt/bass/background/tilted_bianchi_state.py"]
for p in files:
 if p.name=="R62_F1_TESTS.txt" and p.exists():assert sha(p)==report["log_sha256"]
print(json.dumps({"status":"COMPLETED","finding":"R62-FR-01","closure":"CLOSED","assertion_tested":"Original forbidden Type-I counterexample rejects independently of kappa, compensation remains admitted, relative Hamiltonian failure is preserved, and the same valid/invalid IX data retain verdicts under two large unit-scale changes.","typeI":rows,"IX":ix,"input_hashes_before":before,"input_hashes_after":after,"input_changes":[p for p in before if before[p]!=after[p]],"author_targeted_test_receipt":report},indent=2))
